Fixed. The bug was in `inspect_chain` (lib/rubocop/cop/style/dig_chain.rb:286): the correction range was computed as `node.loc.dot.begin_pos + 1`, which assumes a one-char `.` operator. For safe navigation (`&.`), `loc.dot` covers both characters, so the trailing `&` was left in the source, producing `hoge & dig(:a, :b)` and triggering a follow-on `Layout/SpaceAroundOperators` fix. Using `node.loc.selector.begin_pos` (the method-name start, right after `.` or `&.`) yields the correct `hoge&.dig(:a, :b)`.

Validated with `dig_chain_spec.rb` (23/23, including the previously failing safe-navigation chain case), `single_argument_dig_spec.rb`, `safe_navigation_spec.rb` (714 total), and an end-to-end `rubocop -A` run of the issue's repro.
